app.name: Sungrow energy flow
app.summary: Solar, grid, house and battery on one tile, with production and consumption per day on a tap.
app.input_total_hint: A lifetime energy counter in kWh with long-term statistics.
app.input_battery_hint: A lifetime energy counter in kWh. Leave it as it is without a battery.
app.opt_power_hint: A power sensor in W or kW.
app.opt_grid_hint: One signed sensor: positive while the house imports.
app.opt_battery_hint: One signed sensor: positive while the battery discharges.
app.opt_house_hint: Optional. Without it the tile works it out from the other three.
app.opt_string_hint: Optional: the power of one string of panels.
app.opt_invert_grid_hint: For a sensor that is positive while the house exports.
app.opt_invert_battery_hint: For a sensor that is positive while the battery charges.
